meanings.note: the present tense is normally left out: я мэр = I am the mayor
Present есть; у меня есть = I have.

examples.trans: You will be asking for forgiveness.

examples.text: Я завелась? Она специально моё ведро пнула!
examples.trans: Me, worked up? She kicked my bucket on purpose!
Masterpieces aren't served by the bucketful.

meanings.en: after all, still, all the same

examples.text: Аркаш, мне москвичи звонят каждый день. Может, всё-таки передумаем?
examples.trans: Arkasha, the people from Moscow call me every day. Maybe we should reconsider after all?

говорить.gloss: to speak, to say, to talk

meanings.note: Я тебе говорю = I'm telling you.
emphatic at the start of a sentence
на днях = in the next few days, or the other day

examples.trans: I'll call in the next few days.
Any day now, on the website.

meanings.note: + infinitive; agrees with the subject: должна (f)

examples.text: Жадность, Паша, должна быть умеренная. Комнатной температуры.
examples.trans: Greed, Pasha, should be moderate. Room temperature.
Don't make a fool out of me.

examples.text: Вот я дура! Надо было работать на Осипенко.
examples.trans: What a fool I am! I should have worked for Osipenko.

завестись.gloss: to get worked up; to start (of an engine)

meanings.en: (colloquial) to get worked up, to flare up
meanings.note: Ты опять завелась? = Are you getting worked up again?
машина не заводится = the car won't start

examples.trans: Are you getting worked up again?
Guys, why are you so worked up?

заладить.gloss: to keep on (saying), to harp on

meanings.en: to keep repeating the same thing, to harp on
meanings.note: Colloquial, mostly past tense: что ты заладил(а)! = why do you keep saying that!

examples.trans: Why do you keep saying that!
He keeps going on about the same thing.

meanings.note: emphasis: вот поэтому ты и... = that's exactly why you...

examples.trans: I was born and grew up here.

examples.text: Спасибо, спасибо! Как вы все знаете, я родился и вырос в Синеозерске.
examples.trans: Thank you, thank you! As you all know, I was born and grew up in Sineozersk.

examples.text: Конечно, помогу. Кто у вас сейчас начальник?
examples.trans: Of course I'll help. Who's your boss now?

examples.text: Этого не может быть. Это наша история.
examples.trans: That can't be. It's our history.

meanings.note: нас = us (gen/acc/prep); у нас = we have, at our place

meanings.en: other forms: нас (gen/acc), нам (dat), нами (instr), нас (prep)

examples.text: Смотрите, какой у нас грязный унитаз!
examples.trans: Look, how dirty our toilet is!

meanings.note: goes right before the word it negates

examples.text: Работать без отдыха — это ненормальная ситуация.
examples.trans: Working without rest is an abnormal situation.

meanings.note: + genitive: 'у нас нет выбора' = we have no choice
usually in the genitive ничего, with не: ничего не осталось

examples.text: Ну что, очкарик? Видишь, ничего не осталось.
examples.trans: Well, four-eyes? See, there's nothing left.

meanings.note: Russian uses one word for both.

examples.text: Заходите. Поставьте, пожалуйста, правую ногу на кровать.
examples.trans: Come in. Please put your right foot on the bed.

examples.text: Она нашла нас на новом месте.
examples.trans: She found us at the new place.
That is it, she got really offended.
She is not answering her phone.

examples.text: Нина, не слушай. Это опять обман.
examples.trans: Nina, don't listen. It's another trick.

examples.text: Меня уже тошнит от этой коммуналки! У нас труба уже неделю течёт.
examples.trans: I'm sick of this communal flat! Our pipe has been leaking for a week now.

отстать.gloss: to fall behind, to leave alone

examples.trans: He was left behind by the train.

examples.text: Пожалуйста, немедленно отстань от нашей семьи!
examples.trans: Please, immediately leave our family alone!

examples.text: Я завелась? Она специально моё ведро пнула!
examples.trans: I got worked up? She kicked my bucket on purpose!
The cat is under the table.

examples.text: Хорошо, давайте три. Под мою личную ответственность.
examples.trans: All right, let's say three. On my personal responsibility.
Why are we going so slowly?

examples.text: Виталик, почему мы так медленно едем? Быстрее!
examples.trans: Vitalik, why are we going so slowly? Faster!

meanings.note: + instrumental; со before some consonant clusters: со всеми

examples.trans: Share it all equally with everyone, understand?

meanings.note: once; что скажешь? = what do you say?

examples.trans: Tell us, when will your programme be out?

examples.text: Привет! Смотри, что у меня есть.

examples.trans: Are you doing this on purpose?
Are you doing this on purpose or what?

You can see it at once.
Now there's a businesswoman, you can see it at once.

meanings.note: уже четыре года = for four years now

examples.text: Я уже четыре года работаю мэром.
examples.trans: I've been mayor for four years now.

meanings.note: Учить уроки = to do one's homework.

examples.trans: Not allowed? All right, I'll go and do my homework.

examples.text: Какое хорошее утро! Лидия Алексеевна, чашку кофе, пожалуйста.
examples.trans: What a lovely morning! Lidia Alekseyevna, a cup of coffee, please.
If you don't want to, suit yourself.
They want to build a shopping centre there.

examples.text: Привет! Смотри, что у меня есть.

meanings.note: pointing at a thing or a situation; 'это' + noun = 'this is ...'
points at something: это моё = that's mine

meanings.en: other forms: этого, этому, это, этим, этом

examples.trans: And this is for you. A toy car!

meanings.en: other forms: меня (gen/acc), мне (dat), мной (instr), мне (prep)
